profile.headline: Lighthouse Software Engineer
profile.summary: I graduated from Xavier University of Louisiana with a bachelor’s in computer science and a minor in creative writing. I was a campus hire by KPMG in June 2022, and worked as an Engineer Consultant for both commercial and federal branches for a year and a half. As an experienced software engineer from a Big Four company, I used training to engineer a pipeline that allowed clients to efficiently budget their projects, and to further develop skills in cloud engineering. With these tools, I aim to ensure a future where society can technologically advance without the expense of the working class’s future.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
An integral player in the company’s migration to cloud computing and providing cloud solutions to clients.  This included being in the company’s launch of their cloud training program and working alongside internal teams to be able to deliver innovative solutions with the backing of cloud computing.

•	Data Pipeline Project – July 2022-September 2022
•	Created pipeline that allowed clients to efficiently budget projects.
•	Responsible for back-end and database structure; provided API endpoints via Python.
•	Used Azure DevOps to make functions readily available for front-end.
•	Utilized Pyodbc to get and receive information between front-end and database; JSON API was used to mitigate syntax errors.
•	AWS Presentation – October 2022-December 2022
•	Enhanced Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel skills by delivering information about AWS solutions created by KPMG.
•	KPMG UI Migration/Upgrade – January 2023
•	Assisted with transitioning KPMG’s internal site on Microsoft SharePoint. Constraints that existed with the old site included the difficulty of finding articles, as they were not categorized. My role was to mitigate that constraint.
•	Enhanced Excel knowledge by efficiently categorizing old links by industries to which the article content was catered. Doing so allowed co-workers to be more efficient with their tasks to apply the articles’ categories within the updated interface.
•	KPMG Cloud Training Program – February 2023-August 2023
•	Participated in KPMG’s first cloud training program. Developed skills in Google Cloud.
•	Attended daily sessions about Google Cloud. Did Google Cloud Hands-on Labs that allowed me to consistently interact with cloud interface.
•	Did case studies. Implemented solutions like CI/CD Pipeline and Data Transformation, and used cloud apps like Kubernetes, Compute Engine, VPC Network, Artifact Registry, etc.
•	Developed various soft skills that allowed me to properly discuss cloud solutions, execute them, and present them to a client.
positions.insights: Azure DevOps, Python (Programming Language) and +2 skills

positions.title: Google SWE Intern
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Was a part of the Universal App Metadata team. UAM was a mobile app for data processing and data management infrastructure used across various ad-serving stacks. 

•	Implemented functionality in C++ Flume data pipeline to retrieve iOS Bundle IDs, crawl iTunes Search API, and persist returned data into storage.
•	Decreased latency improved safety of UAM, as it used to take up to seven days for data to appear in Enterprise Partner Feed.
•	Created web tool that automated creation of iTunes Search API requests used by Sales to improve latency of new iOS data being consumed via Angular and Java.

positions.title: Google EP (STEP) Intern
positions.description:
Was a part of the DiRT Manager Team. DiRT Manager was an internal web tool that facilitated planning and execution of disaster testing.

•	Built a local web server.
•	Modified existing UI and backend to store and retrieve test relative dependency information from database.
•	Developed SQL queries to retrieve data about test dependencies.
•	Participated in functional and stylistic code reviews to ensure efficiency.
•	Assisted in defining user journeys to ensure that all stakeholder requirements were identified.

projects.title: Fire Emblem Awakening Parody
projects.description:
The overarching goal is to create a tactical role playing strategy game based upon Intelligent System’s Fire Emblem Awakening. 

Currently it’s set up as a text simulator with the code online through repl.it.
